prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless albedo-only source tile for a low-poly fantasy game terrain material
Primary request: Create a repeatable wet delta silt and mud flat ground texture for the inhabited braided channels of Manymouth Delta.
Style/medium: subdued painterly low-poly fantasy ground, medium-scale mottling like Eloria's approved grass and desert albedos, no photorealism.
Composition/framing: flat orthographic square texture with evenly distributed features; opposite left/right edges and opposite top/bottom edges must meet seamlessly when repeated; no border, framing, vignette or center focus.
Color palette: muted grey-brown and warm taupe silt with restrained olive and damp clay variation; no turquoise water color.
Materials/textures: compressed fine delta sediment with soft irregular flood-deposit bands, gentle silty color patches and sparse tiny mineral flecks; moderately detailed but quiet from gameplay distance; intended world repeat about 4 metres.
Lighting/mood: uniform neutral diffuse albedo; identical value at all edges, no illumination variation.
Constraints: both-axis seamless tile; diffuse color only; texture represents ground, not standing water, reeds or plants.
Avoid: broken edge courses, large stones, large centerpiece, cracks, tire tracks, footprints, objects, plants, water, ripples, directional light, gradients, shadows, highlights, specular effects, perspective, horizon, text, logo, frame, watermark.
